1.title: Import Taxes & Duties
1.description: Shipping fees do not include import taxes or customs duties. Import taxes must be paid by the recipient according to local regulations.

2.title: USA & Australia Orders
2.description: For orders shipped to the United States, import taxes will be covered by the sender. Orders shipped to Australia are usually not subject to import taxes.

3.title: Delivery Time
3.description: Some regions in Africa and South America may experience longer shipping times than expected.

faqs.a: Yes! Once your order has been shipped, you'll receive a tracking number via email.

faqs.q: Do shipping fees include import taxes?
faqs.a: No. Import taxes and customs duties are not included in shipping fees.
Import taxes are paid by the recipient according to local customs regulations.
